module: Career starting mode "selfMade" (tier minor, order 300, ignore = true): 1,000 money and a randomly generated old car. setupInventory picks, among the eligible vehicles (util_configListGenerator), those passing a filter (years 1990-2005, value 1000-50000, config types Factory or Service), draws a year, estimates by bisection (28 iterations) the mileage that brings the adjusted value closest to a target of 4000 to 5000, keeps the best candidate, spawns it at (838.51, -522.42, 165.75) with a random paint, adds it to the inventory and fills the tanks to 15%. Description table loaded by career/career.lua, not an extension.
notes: ignore = true: the mode is not offered in this version (inferred from the field name).
Fallback if no vehicle passes the filter: the tutorial Sunburst (sunburst2, apmTutorial_sunburst.pc, year 2005, mileage 250,000,000).
The reference year 2023 is hardcoded in the age calculations.
The entries maxYear, high and rot shown in the auto page are local variables, not module fields.

description.desc: "Start with nothing but a beaten down car, a handful of dollars and a dream."

setupInventory.desc: Generates and spawns the starting car (see module description) and adds it to the inventory with initPartConditions for the estimated mileage.
